title: Near a smooth prime the conormal module is free on some of the given generators
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n,m\ge0$, $P=R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, $f_1,\dots,f_m\in P$, $I=(f_1,\dots,f_m)\subseteq P$ and $A=P/I$; the conormal module $I/I^2$ is an $A$-module. Let $\mathfrak q\subset A$ be a prime ideal such that $R\to A$ is smooth at $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. Then there are $a\in P$ whose image $\bar a\in A$ does not lie in $\mathfrak q$ and a subset $V\subseteq\{1,\dots,m\}$ with $c:=|V|\le\min(n,m)$ such that (i) the localization $A_{\bar a}$ is a smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]; (ii) the localization $(I/I^2)_{\bar a}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away] is a free $A_{\bar a}$-module with basis the classes of $f_j$, $j\in V$; (iii) the module of Kähler differentials $\Omega_{A_{\bar a}/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is a free $A_{\bar a}$-module of rank $n-c$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07C6 (lemma-find-strictly-standard, line 142) and its proof (lines 162-181: (I/I^2)_a -> (+) A_a dx_i split injection for some a not in q by Algebra 00S1 (lemma-NL-homotopy), 00S7 (lemma-localize-NL), Definitions 00T2, 00TB; after shrinking, f_1..f_c a basis of (I/I^2)_a and dx_{c+1},..,dx_n a basis of (Omega_{A/R})_a). The statement records what the proof of 07C6 constructs and what Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting, line 1464, items (1),(2)) takes from it.

proof.text: (A smooth principal neighbourhood and its conormal sequence.) By smoothness at $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal], choose $b\in A\setminus\mathfrak q$ such that $A_b$ is a smooth $R$-algebra, and choose $h\in P$ mapping to $b$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-localization-conormal-split] to $b$: with $M=(I/I^2)_b$ and $F=\bigoplus_{i=1}^nA_b\,\mathrm dx_i$, the localized conormal map gives a split exact sequence $0\to M\to F\to\Omega_{A_b/R}\to0$. Hence $M$ and $\Omega_{A_b/R}$ are finite projective $A_b$-modules: each is a direct summand of the finite free module $F$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07C6 (lemma-find-strictly-standard): Algebra Tags 00S1, 00S7 and Definitions 00T2, 00TB give the split injection after a localization outside q

proof.text: (Select some of the given relations at the prime.) Let $\mathfrak q_b\subset A_b$ be the prime induced by $\mathfrak q$ and $\kappa=\kappa(\mathfrak q)$. The classes of $f_1,\dots,f_m$ generate $I/I^2$, hence their images span $M\otimes_{A_b}\kappa$. Choose a subset $V\subseteq\{1,\dots,m\}$ whose images are a basis, and put $c=|V|$, so $c\le m$. Tensoring the split exact sequence of step 1 with $\kappa$ remains split exact. Its middle term has dimension $n$, and its first term has dimension $c$; therefore $c\le n$ and $\Omega_{A_b/R}\otimes_{A_b}\kappa$ has dimension $n-c$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07C6 (lemma-find-strictly-standard): choose f_1,...,f_c forming a basis of I/I^2 tensor kappa(q)

proof.text: (Spread the prescribed conormal basis.) A finite projective module is finitely presented [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-finitely-presented], and its localization at a prime is finite free [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-rank-locally-constant]. Its rank at $\mathfrak q_b$ is $c$: if $M_{\mathfrak q_b}\cong A_{b,\mathfrak q_b}^{\oplus n}$, then tensoring with $\kappa$ gives $M\otimes_{A_b}\kappa\cong\kappa^{\oplus n}$ (localization at $\mathfrak q_b$ does not change the tensor product with $\kappa$, on which $A_b\setminus\mathfrak q_b$ already acts invertibly), so $n=\dim_\kappa M\otimes_{A_b}\kappa=c$ by step 2. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-prescribed-residue-basis-spreads], applied over $A_b$ to $M$ and the selected classes of the $f_j$, gives $s/1\in A_b\setminus\mathfrak q_b$ such that those same classes form a basis of $M_{s/1}$. Write $s/1=u/b^e$ with $u\in A$; since $s/1\notin\mathfrak q_b$, $u\notin\mathfrak q$, and localizing at $u$ gives the same result after possibly also inverting $b$. Put $a=hu\in P$. Its image $\bar a=bu$ is outside $\mathfrak q$, $(I/I^2)_{\bar a}$ is free on the classes of $f_j$, $j\in V$, and $A_{\bar a}=(A_b)_{u/1}$ is smooth over $R$ by [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-principal-localization].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07C6 (lemma-find-strictly-standard): after replacing a by aa' outside q, the selected f_j form a basis of (I/I^2)_a

proof.text: (Spread the basis of differentials and take a common shrink.) The finite projective $A_b$-module $N=\Omega_{A_b/R}$ is finitely presented [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-finitely-presented], and by step 2 its localization at $\mathfrak q_b$ is free of rank $n-c$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-free-at-prime-spreads] to obtain $t/1\in A_b\setminus\mathfrak q_b$ such that $N_{t/1}$ is free of rank $n-c$. Choose a numerator $v\in A\setminus\mathfrak q$ for $t/1$ and replace the element $a=hu$ of step 3 by $huv$. Further localization preserves the basis of $(I/I^2)_{bu}$ and smoothness, while $N_{uv}=(\Omega_{A_b/R})_{uv}$ is canonically $\Omega_{A_{buv}/R}$ by [lem-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials-localization]. Thus this $a$ and $V$ satisfy (i)--(iii).
